subject: Status: conditional GON prototype + a calibration trade-off
body:
Hi Ximena, Bruno,

Status ahead of the 4/29 review. The simulation repro confirmed the published pattern: GON maximizer estimates were statistically significantly better than the convex fit, GPR and DNN baselines on our noisy test functions, and recovering the maximizer really is O(D) - milliseconds even at D=64.

Yara's conditional GON prototype is running on the internal threshold-tuning problem: it finds a global maximizer conditioned on the customer-segment inputs, which is exactly the query shape the tuning team wants.

The trade-off to discuss: enforcing unimodality via the lattice linear-inequality constraints costs us fit quality when the true response surface is mildly multimodal. On one segment the constrained fit underestimates the peak by ~6%. We think that is the honest price of an auditable guarantee, but the review should say so explicitly rather than bury it.

Gustavo
